## Featured Projects
- [DomoDomo](https://domodomo.site/): Multi-purpose, open-source web utility suite for high-performance file conversions, image editing, and PDF manipulation directly in the browser. 100% client-side, WebGPU-accelerated, privacy-first.
- [Koncentrate](https://github.com/Ram-Gold/koncentrate): KDE Plasma 6 desktop widget combining a Pomodoro focus timer with an integrated To-Do list, built in C++, Qt/QML for Linux.
- [Idol Chant & Mixes](https://idol-mixes.vercel.app/): Centralized web platform for wotagei culture, idol chants, calls, and mixes built with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS.
- [Pubmats & Graphic Design](https://ram-gold.github.io/Personal-Website/?view=pubmats): Graphic design portfolio featuring promotional event flyers and commemorative materials.
